resources.string: Save this directory as a location
Save this account and starting directory in this app. No password is saved. This directory is a starting point, not a boundary on remote access. Sharing requires a separate action.
Enter a name of 1–80 characters without control characters. Very long edits are not applied.
Private location saved: %1$s. Open Saved file locations to manage it after disconnecting.
Registration may have completed. Inspect saved locations before creating another record.
Refresh this directory to prepare a new registration.
